Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer misinterpreted the Britannica page by extracting "Reading, Berkshire, England" as the birthplace, whereas the text clearly stated he was "raised" there. This data fabrication created a false discrepancy that forced the Planner into a long loop of redundant verification steps, delaying the final correct answer.
